record.question: Who is present Secretary General of United Nations Organisation?
record.explanation: Answer A: Ban Ki Moon. The UN’s historical succession record gives Ban Ki-moon’s term as January 2007–December 2016; he held office on 24 March 2010. Historical/source note: Historical officeholder, not the present Secretary-General. Reference: https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/former-secretaries-general. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
